headline: Exchanges Take In $735 Million As Bitcoin Falls 1.70 Percent To 80k
narrative: Crypto exchanges took in $735 million over 24 hours, equal to 0.275 percent of reserves, a distribution print as coins arrived on venues. Bitcoin fell 1.70 percent and changed hands near 80k, so that inventory landed into a lower spot price. Cumulative volume delta printed -185.79, the 26th percentile of the past 30 days, sell-side leaning in the same pipe.
author: jordan
